external_entities.description: Users whose typed content may appear in prompts sent by calling teams.

external_entities.name: ML engineer
external_entities.description: Engineers who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server, and writes requests and responses to the inference log.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and loads model artifacts at startup and customer features during requests.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket holding model artifacts loaded by the model server and published to by ML engineers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network. ... The features include account age and spend bands per customer.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that may contain what users typed.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging
data_stores.notes: The source further states: "That means raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed."

data_flows.name: send requests
data_flows.description: Other teams' backends send inference requests to the gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.notes: Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired: "Keys are issued per calling team and we have never expired one."

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password: "Redis has no password on it; it is only reachable inside the model network."
data_flows.data_description: Customer features including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write inference log
data_flows.description: The gateway writes every request and response to the inference log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: Every request and response, including raw prompts

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the model registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.notes: The source is uncertain about authorization: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network location to which the inference gateway is exposed.

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store, intended to be reachable only from the gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway

assumptions.assumption: The FastAPI inference gateway presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source describes it as a FastAPI service, which presents an HTTP-family application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The customer features in the Redis feature store are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the features include account age and spend bands per customer, which are customer-related data whose disclosure may harm individuals or the business.
